# Statistical analysis in R

This notebook presents the **statistical analysis** of the movement analysis project.

The dataset used here was previously created in Python and saved as:

- `data/Global_Jump_Height.xlsx`

The analysis focuses on the variable:

- **Jump Height (Flight Time) [cm]**

for the two jump conditions:

- **Squat Jump (SJ)**
- **Countermovement Jump (CMJ)**

The purpose of this R notebook is to:

- describe the data,
- compute the paired difference between CMJ and SJ,
- assess the normality of the paired differences,
- perform the appropriate paired statistical test,
- estimate the effect size.

# Load the data

The cleaned file generated in Python is imported below.

```{r load_and_analysis, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


#----- 1. Load required packages ------

library(readxl)
library(effsize)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

#----- 2. Import the cleaned dataset -----

df <- read_xlsx("data/Global_Jump_Height.xlsx")


#----- 3. Convert variables to numeric -----

df$SJ_Mean <- as.numeric(df$SJ_Mean)
df$CMJ_Mean <- as.numeric(df$CMJ_Mean)


#----- 4. Compute the paired difference -----

df$Delta <- df$CMJ_Mean - df$SJ_Mean


#----- 5. Descriptive statistics -----

mean_SJ <- mean(df$SJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_SJ   <- sd(df$SJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)

mean_CMJ <- mean(df$CMJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_CMJ   <- sd(df$CMJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)

mean_delta <- mean(df$Delta, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_delta   <- sd(df$Delta, na.rm = TRUE)

desc_table <- data.frame(
  Condition = c("SJ", "CMJ", "CMJ - SJ"),
  Mean = c(mean_SJ, mean_CMJ, mean_delta),
  SD = c(sd_SJ, sd_CMJ, sd_delta)
)

kable(
  desc_table,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Descriptive statistics for jump height"
)


#----- 6. Normality of paired differences -----

shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(df$Delta)

#----- 7. Paired t-test -----

ttest_result <- t.test(df$CMJ_Mean, df$SJ_Mean, paired = TRUE)

# ----- 8. Effect size -----

effect_size <- cohen.d(df$CMJ_Mean, df$SJ_Mean, paired = TRUE)

infer_table <- data.frame(
  Test = c("Shapiro-Wilk", "Paired t-test", "Effect size"),
  Statistic = c(
    round(unname(shapiro_result$statistic), 4),
    round(unname(ttest_result$statistic), 4),
    round(effect_size$estimate, 4)
  ),
  `p-value` = c(
    round(shapiro_result$p.value, 4),
    signif(ttest_result$p.value, 3),
    NA
  ),
  Interpretation = c(
    "Normality assumption respected",
    "Significant difference between CMJ and SJ",
    "Large effect"
  )
)

kable(
  infer_table,
  caption = "Inferential statistics"
)
```

The results showed that:

- mean jump height was 34.70 ± 2.98 cm in SJ,
- mean jump height was 38.27 ± 3.26 cm in CMJ,

- the mean paired difference (CMJ - SJ) was 3.57 ± 2.02 cm,

- the normality assumption was respected (W = 0.9762, p = 0.9638),

- the paired t-test was significant (t(11) = 6.1163, p = 7.56e-05),

- the effect size was large (Cohen's d = 1.13)
